paragraphs: The name of a gentile, mentioned in the time of Abaye. [Eruvin 63b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.63b.11).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara calls him Lachman bar Ristak and describes his neighbors asking to rent his share of the alleyway. Hyman gives Lachman or Haman.

Both Lachman and Haman are supplied alternatives. עכו״ם, literally idolater, is Hyman’s term rendered gentile; the notice places him in Abaye’s time without fresh historical admission. No separate personal title is supplied.
